mapper.sql: id, student_code, full_name, date_of_birth, gender, disability_type, support_level, enrollment_date, class_group, notes, active, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (student_code, full_name, date_of_birth, gender, disability_type, support_level, enrollment_date, class_group, notes, active) VALUES (#{studentCode}, #{fullName}, #{dateOfBirth}, #{gender}, #{disabilityType}, #{supportLevel}, #{enrollmentDate}, #{classGroup}, #{notes}, #{active})
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET active = #{active} WHERE id = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE student_code = #{studentCode} AND id <> #{excludeId}
